metaTitle: Custom Embroidery Chef Wear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery chef wear for your team. Durable, professional aprons and coats with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Embroidery adds a premium, lasting finish to chef wear that screen printing or heat transfers can't match. For restaurants, culinary schools, and food service teams, embroidered logos on aprons and chef coats resist fading through hundreds of commercial washes. Choose thread colors that match your brand identity, and place your logo on chest pockets, left sleeves, or center back for maximum visibility. Poly-cotton blends take embroidery cleanly without puckering, giving your staff a crisp, professional look every shift.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery chef wear with embroidered logo on a white chef coat
